description: Keeps the digest-pinned base images (Dockerfile, docker/fakemedia.Dockerfile) and the SHA-pinned actions (the workflow directories) current. Renovate reads this file wherever it runs; on GitHub, install the Renovate app for the repository (it only opens pull requests: nothing is merged automatically). Go modules and npm packages are updated by hand (go get, npm update) and gated in CI by govulncheck and npm audit; on GitHub, Dependabot security updates (a repository setting, no dependabot.yml) cover them, so the two bots never propose the same update.

packageRules.description: Go and Node: stay on the minor and major lines the project targets (go.mod, the CI workflows); only patch releases and digests are proposed.
New base image digests carry security fixes: group them in one pull request.
Supply chain: propose a new action release only once it has been public for 3 days, so a compromised or retracted tag is usually caught before it is pinned here.
